what_this_is: Entailment of every claim the shipped system (uncitable claims withheld after generation) displayed on the frozen 134-question probe set, judged against the passage it cited. Model-judged, two blind passes plus adjudication, with a derangement control arm. NOT a clinician's judgement of clinical correctness.

provenance.arm: the shipped system (uncitable claims withheld after generation)

judge.decoding: not set; harness defaults, so the passes are not bitwise reproducible
judge.model_checkpoint: NOT RECOVERABLE: no script pins a model, so each judge subagent inherited the session's model. Family is Anthropic Claude via Claude Code. See the configuration file; the paper states this as a limitation rather than naming a version it cannot prove.

human_check.graded_by: the author, blind to the model labels and to the strata

stratum_B_model_supported.kind: sample of 24 of 179, allocated by question type
stratum_B_model_supported.precision_note: Measured on the 24 sampled claims, not on all 179. With 24 of 24 the exact lower bound is 0.86, so the sample is consistent with as many as 14 % of the 179 being claims a reader would not call supported.

human_supported_rate.method: census stratum contributes exactly; sampled stratum by exact Clopper-Pearson, conservative because the draw is without replacement from a finite population
human_supported_rate.why_post_stratified: Stratum A is 6 of 185 claims but 6 of 30 sheet items, so it is over-represented about thirtyfold by design; read naively the sheet understates the rate.
human_supported_rate.why_not_a_bootstrap: An earlier version bootstrapped both strata and reported [0.973, 0.995]. Stratum A is a census, so resampling it invents states that cannot occur, and the upper bound exceeded 0.9838, the maximum the design can express.

overstated.why_it_matters: An over-strong claim wearing a real quotation is the failure mode this paper predicts. Neither judge found one at the claim layer, which is consistent with the extractor copying passage sentences rather than authoring claims.
